info.name: Aesthetic Pink Gmail Theme
info.description: Transform your Gmail into a visually pleasing, soft pink wonderland with this custom Stylish theme. Featuring delicate shades of pink and white, this theme balances beauty and functionality. Buttons, sidebars, and interactive elements are styled with soft gradients and hover effects for an elegant and modern feel. Perfect for anyone who loves a gentle, eye-soothing aesthetic! ?
info.additionalInfo:
Version: 1.0
Release Date: December 18, 2024

Features:
Soft white-pink backgrounds to reduce eye strain and create a calming atmosphere.
Interactive elements like buttons and links styled in shades of pink (#ec9ec0, #d78ba9) for a cohesive, polished look.
Hover effects on buttons and emails for a smooth, modern feel.
Enhanced readability with neutral gray text (#5a5a5a) against light backgrounds.
Subtle rounded corners and clean design for a softer, more elegant aesthetic.
Updates:
Initial release with full Gmail theme customization.
Includes support for sidebars, emails, buttons, and hover interactions.
